title: Mehtab Singh meets martyrdom and Bhai Taru Singh is summoned

blocks.text: This page closes the Mehtab Singh episode as Haribhagat Niranjania seizes him, carries him toward Lahore, and allows him a final sight of Bhai Taru Singh before martyrdom. The account dwells on Mehtab Singh's execution on the spoked wheel as an act of fearless witness rather than defeat.

Even in custody, the Singh remains spiritually triumphant, and Taru Singh is said to rejoice at the martyr's steadfastness. The page therefore serves as both a memorial to Mehtab Singh and a preparation for the next trial awaiting the Panth.
By the end of the page, the narrative turns toward Bhai Taru Singh's own appearance before authority. It works as a hinge that closes one martyrdom and opens the next confrontation with Mughal power.
